name: Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara
description: Nara was Japan's capital from 710 to 784, and eight sites around the city still preserve that era: five Buddhist temples, a Shinto shrine, a primeval forest and the excavated grounds of the Imperial Palace. Together they hold 26 National Treasure buildings. Wander through Nara Park, where the great temples of Tōdai-ji and Kōfuku-ji stand, and you step into the world of 8th-century Japan.
